scope: Selected wall windows, exclusive main-thread counts. Phase position and inline attribution change function shares; shares alone are not causal speedup measurements.

profile.containmentScope: 300 seconds after observed initial stopped state; independent 300-second startup watchdog

cpu.scope: Total inferior process CPU since launch, including loader work. Final unobserved wall bounds missing CPU; the observer does not affect native execution or debugger state.

nodeContext.causalRegression: Unproven: one comparison under load, no repeated CPU/cycle cohort.
nodeContext.unfinishedLeftShiftCPU: 45m41.60s; Node/V8 descriptor/property stacks, before native entry.
nodeContext.scope: Node-hosted compiler context, not generated native execution; no codegen speedup extrapolation.
